tool.description: Generate a fresh ECDSA key pair on a NIST prime curve (p256, p384, or p521) and return the private key (PKCS#8 PEM) and public key (SPKI PEM). Optionally also output JSON Web Keys (RFC 7517) by setting jwk=true. Keys are generated locally with a cryptographic RNG. Default curve is p256.

curve.description: NIST prime curve: p256 (secp256r1), p384 (secp384r1), or p521 (secp521r1). Default p256.

jwk.description: Also output the keys as JSON Web Keys (RFC 7517), in addition to PEM. Default false.
